The trace normal form, necessity and sufficiency of the ± residue criterion for integral similarity, the trace-zero boundary, and the class counts are derived explicitly. The finite checker only tests formulas on bounded inputs and is not used to establish the infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: The inspected 2026 source has the regularity premise and one witness, while the 2016 source has the row-form fine criterion. value.rationale: The result replaces an isolated counterexample in the motivating 2026 paper by an exact classification of the entire rank-one regular obstruction in M_2(Z): trace strata, class counts, unique fine orbit, a sharp first bad trace magnitude, and vanishing fine-class density along prime traces. This is a natural complete structural slice of the new regular-fine question rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
